tests.title: parses named and positional options with native defaults, constants and ranges, and refuses everything else with exact messages
sizes the ring as config_input does and truncates nbuf to an even sample count
pins dbl for every input format, refuses non-stereo layouts and plans an unchanged count with the ring reservation
matches a transcription of the C loop for every mode and option family, identical for 1/7/29/50-sample splits, without touching its input
refuses non-stereo frames, rate changes, non-finite samples, oversized rings and frames, emits nothing for empty input and observes cancellation
matches native PCM bytes for every mode at default levels, mute, phase inversion and delay at 8000/44100 Hz from every source format
matches native PCM bytes for non-default levels, side and middle balance, base, balance modes and delay with base (linux/x64)
matches native WAV, raw and framecrc for copy-like options across frame splits, volume, apad, WAV input and output selection
matches native WAV, raw and framecrc for float-sensitive options across frame splits, volume, apad, WAV input and output selection (linux/x64)
refuses softclip, phase, mono, out-of-range, unimplemented and enable= forms before output, beside native status

unsupported: expressions, SI suffixes and non-literal values
non-stereo input (mono, 3+ channels, non-default WAV/W64 masks)
non-finite input samples and NaN results

proposedContracts.name: matches a transcription of the C loop for every mode and option family, identical for 1/7/29/50-sample splits, without touching its input
proposedContracts.scope: C-loop transcription, frame-split independence, input ownership

notes: Ring of FFALIGN((sr+9)/10,2) doubles with pos persists across frames; nbuf=(int)(sr*(fabs(delay)/1000.)) rounded down to even; reserve() is one frame plus the ring as stateBytes.

Delay with default levels runs on all platforms: base=0 makes every base product exactly 0 and default levels make every mix product by 1, so FMA contraction cannot change results. Linux gating of non-default levels/base/balance is a precaution; no macOS difference was measured in this sandbox.
Native-only probe: native output at asetnsamples=n=1/7/29/50:p=0 equals the ungrouped output (12 probes).
Non-finite input samples and NaN results are refused at run time because the generated NaN sign is host-dependent; integer inputs cannot reach either.
Sandbox Node: preinstalled Node 24 (/opt/node24, v24.22.3); the default sandbox Node was v22 and bootstrap requires 24.

Setup durations: bootstrap total 169s (npm 8.5s, submodule 7.0s, reference build 152.3s, unpinned sandbox build); baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries+registry unit tests 52s. Differential file runs in about 22s, unit file in about 4s.
No shared edit beyond the registry line was needed.
